label: Bible Study
prompt: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye _____ not.
verse: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.
note: James' blunt diagnosis — some go without simply because they never asked God.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And, behold, I come _____; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
verse: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
note: Near the Bible's last page, Jesus promises: I come quickly, and my reward is with me.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a _____ mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
verse: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
note: Pentecost began with a sound from heaven like a rushing mighty wind, filling the whole house.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For I was _____ to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.
verse: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.
note: Ezra had bragged to the king about God's protection, so he was too embarrassed to ask for a military escort.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: There the wicked cease from _____; and there the weary be at rest.
verse: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest.
note: Job, wishing he'd never been born, pictures the grave as rest: there the wicked cease from 'troubling,' and the weary rest.
